description: WFS Veloinfrastruktur Radwege und Radstreifen auf Staatsstrassen und Velorouten is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoinformation Kanton Zürich. Die Veloinfrastruktur wird in einen baulich abgetrennten Fahrbereich (Radwege) und einen durch Markierung abgetrennten Fahrbereich (Radstreifen) unterteilt. Die Radwege und Radstreifen der Veloinfrastruktur von allen Staatsstrassen sowie den nationalen, regionalen und lokalen Velorouten werden mit diesen Daten dokumentiert. Coverage: Geoinformation Kanton Zürich. The portal files it under the publisher Geoinformation Kanton Zürich. It offers 1 resource(s) in WFS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
